title: sharing-server: Principal name/description localizable; ShareNotification name stays base
description:
jmap-sharing-server (with sharing-types): Principal `name` and `description` are localizable.
- name: not nullable. description: nullable.
- ShareNotification `name` (RFC 9670 3) is NOT localizable; fill it with the base value.
Also check the Principal /query name filter against the text-handling child: compare with the sort collation.
notes:
From .5: same /query wiring as .7 for Principal/query and /queryChanges (name filter and sort).
Done 2026-11-15. Principal/query delegated to the generic handle_query, so jmap-server gained handle_query_with_i18n / handle_query_changes_with_i18n (using-aware). The sharing memory backend evaluates no name filter or sort (unsupportedFilter/unsupportedSort), so language changes only queryState there; the bead's 'name filter vs sort collation' check is moot for the reference backend and belongs to text handling (JMAP-cayv.15) for real backends. ShareNotification name: the workspace does not generate notifications; the rustdoc on its JmapObject impl says to fill name with the base value.
close_reason: Principal name/description localizable: type fields, /set checks, /get view, /query+/queryChanges via new handle_query*_with_i18n, memory backend pruning; ShareNotification excluded; 4 tests
